This term included a text file containing the following from the artist:

First of all, thanks for checking me out this month. It’s been very busy with various events and a bout of illness pushing releases back, but thanks to your support Magi Monthly has been able to keep schedule! If you came to visit at a convention, thank you for stopping by! I‘ll also be at AnimeNYC and San Japan, I hope to meet more of you there.

We’re at term 80 now…two years since MM began featuring two full illustrations in each term—to commemorate, I wanted to do a similar yet different composition to term 56(carwashing) for the main illustration. If you hadn’t already noticed the parallels, I hope you’ll compare the two!

Since it’s still hot, the girls are visiting the beach this time. Himari and Lily are childhood friends and find fun in visiting any kind of place and documenting their time. Panda loves to be the center of attention but Minami doesn’t have a high opinion of most men; it makes guys who want to approach them extremely confused.

I hope new, longtime and returning members alike can find something to enjoy in this one! I’ll get you Minami fans next time…!

まずは、今月も支援してくれてありがとうございます。さまざまなイベントや体調不良が重なっても皆様のおかげで、magi monthlyは予定通りに発行を続けてこられました。

もうTerm80、か…毎月イラスト2枚の実装から２年ですね。お祝いに、Term56(洗車)に似てるけど違うような構図をメインにしたいと思いました。もう気付いたかもしれませんけど、是非比べてみてください。

まだまだ暑い季節だし、今回はビーチです。ひまりちゃんとリリーちゃんは幼馴染なので、一緒に時間を過ごすだけで楽しめるという関係です。パンダちゃんはさすがに男子と大人気 注目の的になるのが好きな女ですけど、美波ちゃんが男嫌いだし、ナンパしようと思ってる男性たちは戸惑わせる。

新規、長年、そして再入会された皆様それぞれ今回に楽しめるものが見つかるといいな ^^
美波派、我慢してください…！
